header.title: Turn on your payouts
header.subtitle: To deposit your sales, Stripe (the company that processes payments on Selene) needs to verify who you are. It is free and takes about 5 minutes.

guidance.phoneDesc: Stripe sends you an <resaltar>SMS code</resaltar> to create your account.
guidance.ineDesc: Enter your name, date of birth and address exactly as they appear on your <resaltar>INE</resaltar>.
guidance.clabeDesc: Stripe deposits your sales into your bank account with your 18-digit <resaltar>CLABE</resaltar>.
guidance.termsNote: At the end you accept Stripe's terms and return to Selene automatically.

statusNotice.pendingDesc: What you already entered is saved. Tap Continue on Stripe to finish. If you already finished, Stripe is reviewing your details and we will let you know here.
statusNotice.rejectedTitle: Stripe needs you to fix something
statusNotice.rejectedDesc: Open Stripe to see which detail is missing or needs a correction.
statusNotice.expiredDesc: This happens if you took a while or left halfway. What you already entered is saved: tap Continue on Stripe to pick up where you left off.

paymentExplanation.title: How seller payments work
paymentExplanation.buyerReview: 1. After delivery, the buyer has up to 48 hours to review the product and can confirm early. Eligible purchases complete automatically if no problem is reported.
paymentExplanation.release: 2. Selene reviews eligible completed purchases daily to manage payment release. Completion is not a bank deposit, and daily review does not promise a specific release date.
paymentExplanation.bank: 3. Bank processing normally takes 1–4 business days after the deposit is initiated, not from purchase or completion. This is an estimate; arrival dates may vary.
paymentExplanation.delays: First payments may take longer due to Stripe's initial waiting period. Unavailable funds or requests for additional information may also delay payment.

success.title: You are ready to sell
success.subtitle: Stripe can now deposit your sales. You can print your shipping labels.

loading.title: Checking your Stripe status
loading.subtitle: We're confirming whether you can already receive payments before showing the steps.

errors.statusUnavailable: We couldn't check your Stripe status. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.refreshFailed: We couldn't refresh your Stripe status. Showing the saved information.
errors.onboardingUrlUnavailable: Stripe did not return a registration link. Try again.
errors.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.
